line.name: E.P. Carrillo Short Run 2016 Edicion Nicaragua
line.background_text: Released alongside standard Short Run 2016, an all-Nicaraguan-puro variant using the same binder/filler as the original but with a Nicaraguan wrapper. Moved from limited to regular production alongside the standard release in late 2016.

research_notes: This is specifically 'Short Run 2016 Edicion Nicaragua' (tied to the 2016 vintage), not a persistent generically-named 'Short Run Nicaragua' sub-line. No dedicated critic review with a numeric score located; size/box-count inferred from the same Super Toro format as standard Short Run 2016 - lower confidence.
